tools.name: search_promotions
tools.description: Find current promotions in Singapore (1-for-1s, discounts, freebies, cashback). Use when someone asks 'any deals on X?', 'what's on promotion this weekend?', or about a brand. Returns deals that have not ended, with dates in Singapore time, conditions and the original source link.

tools.name: nearby_promotions
tools.description: Find current promotions closest to a location in Singapore, nearest first, with distance in km. Use when someone asks 'deals near me', 'promotions around Tampines' (pass that area's coordinates). Only deals with a mapped outlet are returned.

tools.name: recommend_promotions
tools.description: Given promotion ids someone liked or saved, return other current deals they may like (same brand, same kind of food or shop, nearby, similar offer), each with a short reason.

tools.name: get_promotion
tools.description: Full details of one promotion by its id (from a search result): dates, conditions, outlets, source link, and links to add it to a calendar or save it with a start reminder. Pass lat/lng to sort outlets nearest first and get nearest_outlet.

tools.name: get_deal_list
tools.description: A curated list of current Singapore deals: ending-soon (last chance), starting-soon, 1-for-1, free (freebies), birthday (birthday treats), students. Use for questions like 'what deals end this week?' or 'any freebies today?'.

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List brands that have at least one current promotion in Singapore, with how many each has.
